opportunity.description: Defense Health Agency PAE Digital Medical Solutions, EIDS PMO, seeks commercial solutions for Data Exchange Platform (DxP) operations, sustainment, modernization and development. The DxP processes real-time clinical and operational data exchanged with more than 15 external systems and partners and enables secure, standards-based interoperability among DHA, the Department of Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare partners. The Government wants reliable, secure, continuously available legacy services while modernizing toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, standards-based and AI/ML-ready capabilities. Issued under DHA Commercial Solutions Opening HT003826SC005. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: The opportunity requires operating, sustaining, modernizing, and developing a Data Exchange Platform processing real-time clinical and operational data with external partners (Claim #1), which is far beyond the company's past performance in training and education data systems.

The requirement includes secure, standards-based interoperability and transitioning to scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, AI/ML-ready capabilities (Claim #3), but the company has only 11 staff, no facility clearance, and no demonstrated experience in cloud-native, API-driven, or AI/ML health data platforms.

The award history shows a median of top awards at $237M (context), while the company's largest past contract is ~$1.5M, indicating a massive scale mismatch for a full-and-open competition (set-aside NONE).

risks: Severe past performance gap: clinical health data exchange vs. training/education analytics
Technical capability gap: cloud-native, API-driven, AI/ML-ready requirements vs. no evidence of such expertise
Scale mismatch: 11-person firm vs. likely large-team requirement for DoD health platform
Full-and-open competition against large established defense health IT contractors
No facility clearance for potential classified/sensitive health data work
nextSteps: Pursue smaller, set-aside opportunities in training/education data analytics matching past performance
Consider teaming as a subcontractor on health data tasks if a prime seeks WOSB/EDWOSB participation
Build cloud-native/API/AI-ML capabilities through smaller contracts before targeting large platform efforts

classification.summary: The buyer seeks commercial solutions to operate, sustain, modernize, and develop a Data Exchange Platform that processes real-time clinical and operational data with external partners, ensuring secure, standards‑based interoperability and transitioning to scalable, cloud‑native, API‑driven, AI/ML‑ready capabilities.
